## Checklist
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run lint` pass (0 lint errors)
- [ ] A test covers the change (label wording, adapter case, or harness)
- [ ] No new permission, host permission, content script, network call, or second click path
- [ ] No personal data in code, tests, fixtures, docs or screenshots (no real saved pages)
- [ ] Documentation matches the code (nothing claimed that is not implemented)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
